title: Mirzapur
hook: Before Mirzapur Season 4: Three seasons of gun-and-carpet corridor power struggles left Kaleen Bhaiya revealed alive, Guddu in Lucknow jail, and Zarina positioning herself for the Chief Minister's chair. Here is what you need to remember.

sections.heading: Season 1: Kaleen Bhaiya and the Pandit boys
sections.body: The debut season establishes the feudal-crime world of Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh. Kaleen Bhaiya, played by Pankaj Tripathi, runs the Tripathi crime dynasty with stillness rather than volume - one of Indian streaming's first canonical villain performances. Engineering students Guddu and Bablu Pandit get pulled into the orbit of the Tripathi family. The premiere landed as mixed-to-positive, but audience response was decisive: over 93,000 IMDb votes at 8.4. The season ends on a cliffhanger that made a sequel inevitable.

sections.heading: Season 2: Revenge and a broader war
sections.body: Season 2 (2020) delivers the revenge arc Season 1 demanded. Guddu, now motivated by loss, drives the season's emotional momentum. The scale is broader and more expensive than Season 1, expanding the cast of power claimants across Mirzapur and beyond. Audience response was strong, consistent with the franchise's installed base. The season ends with Guddu ascendant and the Tripathi dynasty fractured.

sections.heading: Season 3: Politics, Sharad's choice, and the Kaleen reveal
sections.body: Season 3 (July 2024) broadens to Uttar Pradesh state politics. Madhuri becomes Chief Minister, Sharad Shukla aligns with her political project, and Zarina positions herself as a kingmaker-turned-CM-aspirant. Critics were broadly unconvinced - Shubha Gupta in The Indian Express gave it two stars. The season ends with its biggest revelation: Kaleen Bhaiya is alive. Sharad chooses Madhuri over vengeance on Guddu. Guddu surrenders in Lucknow jail. The CM's death is confirmed as murder.

need_to_know.q: Is Kaleen Bhaiya dead or alive going into Mirzapur Season 4?
need_to_know.a: Alive. The Season 3 finale reveals Kaleen Bhaiya survived. His presence resets the power dynamics heading into Season 4.

need_to_know.q: Where is Guddu at the end of Mirzapur Season 3?
need_to_know.a: Guddu surrenders voluntarily in Lucknow jail at the end of Season 3. He is in custody heading into Season 4.

need_to_know.q: What is Zarina's position at the start of Mirzapur Season 4?
need_to_know.a: Zarina has claimed credit for toppling Madhuri's government and is positioning herself for the Chief Minister's chair, framing her ambition as a solo project with no coalition obligations.
